mods.name: Specialist Dance
mods.description: Celebrate valuable items with a Specialist dance animation in your screen.

releases.notes:
## Specialist Dance 1.4.0 — Dance Packs + Layout

Your own dance frames, and control over where the animation appears. A folder of PNGs becomes a selectable dance, and the result can be positioned and resized in-game.

### Added

- User dance packs from `.minecraft/config/specialist-dance/dances/<name>/` — a folder of `frame_000.png … frame_NNN.png` becomes a selectable dance.
- `activeDance` config field and a **Dance pack** selector in the **K** menu.
- **Position dance** screen — drag the animation anywhere, scroll to zoom, with **Center**, **Fit** and reset buttons; the choice is saved on close.
- **Open music folder** and **Open dances folder** buttons in the **K** menu, so custom content is one click away.
- **Rescan** button — picks up music files and dance packs added since launch without restarting the game.
- **Preview dance on close** button in the config screen.
- `tools/GifToFrames.java`, which converts an animated GIF into a dance pack.

### Changed

- The frame count is detected per pack instead of hardcoded to 147.
- The config screen lays out every row from a computed cursor, so the dance controls no longer collide with **Done** at short window heights.
- Animation end behaviors renamed to `stop`, `hold` and `loop`, all of which clear when the music stops; the old `loop-until-music-ends` migrates to `loop`.

### Fixed

- Dance frames now scale to the stage instead of cropping the top-left corner.
- Dance frames draw at their true aspect ratio — the bundled `specialist` frames (498×351) had been stretched into a square box since v1.0.0.
- Text colors use ARGB so they render correctly in 1.21.11.
- MP3, FLAC and WAV tracks no longer upload an empty OpenAL buffer, which played back silently.
- The animation is cleared on world change and on death.

### Installation

- Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.1
- Fabric API 0.141.5+1.21.11
- Client-side only; not required on the server

Download `specialist-dance-1.4.0.jar` and place it in your `mods/` folder.

### Known limitations

PNG is the only loadable frame format — `NativeImage.read` rejects anything without a PNG header, so GIF, JPEG and WebP must be converted first with `tools/GifToFrames.java`. Pack folders and files must be lowercase with no spaces (`frame_000.png`, …). Ogg Opus and ALAC music are not supported.

## Specialist Dance 1.3.1 — More Music Formats

Custom music now supports more common formats. The bundled track and existing `.ogg` files still work the same way.

### Changed

- Custom music supports Ogg Vorbis, WAV, AIFF (`.aiff`/`.aif`), AU, MP3 and FLAC files.
- Java Sound decoders (`javasound-mp3`, `javasound-flac`) are bundled via jar-in-jar for wider format support.
- Music scanning and decoding handle multiple formats while keeping STB Vorbis for `.ogg`.

### Installation

- Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.1
- Fabric API 0.141.5+1.21.11
- Client-side only; not required on the server

Download `specialist-dance-1.3.1.jar` and place it in your `mods/` folder.

### Known limitations

Ogg Opus and ALAC are not supported. Files added while the game is running are not picked up until the next launch.

## Specialist Dance 1.3.0 — Sound On

Dance music is here. When a dance triggers, the selected track plays and stops with the animation.

### Added

- Dance-triggered music with a bundled `default` Ogg Vorbis track.
- Music settings screen opened with **K** — enable/disable music, adjust volume, select a track, preview it, and stop playback.
- Custom music support from `.minecraft/config/specialist-dance/music/`. Filenames become track names and `default` is reserved for the bundled track.
- `musicEnabled`, `musicVolume`, and `musicTrack` config fields.
- Fallback to the bundled `default` track when the selected custom track is missing or cannot be loaded.

### Changed

- Music restores the previous OpenAL context after playback and shutdown instead of clearing it.
- Buffer loading and shutdown now guard OpenAL context and object IDs.

### Fixed

- Shutdown no longer clears Minecraft's active OpenAL context.
- Tracks with more than two channels are downmixed to stereo for playback.

### Installation

- Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.18.1
- Fabric API 0.141.5+1.21.11
- Client-side only; not required on the server

Download `specialist-dance-1.3.0.jar` and place it in your `mods/` folder.

### Known limitations

Custom music currently supports Ogg Vorbis only. Ogg Opus, MP3, WAV, FLAC, and ALAC are not supported yet. Files added while the game is running are not picked up until the next launch.

releases.notes:
## What's new

The big one: the dance is now **origin-aware**. It only plays when you mine a valuable ore and pick up the drop from that ore.

Before, any diamond pickup counted — a chest, a trade, a mob, or loot lying on the ground would all fire the animation. Now each broken ore remembers its position, the drop that comes out of it gets linked back to that ore, and only a pickup of *that* item triggers the dance.

### Changed

- The trigger is origin-aware — chests, trades, mobs and pre-existing ground items no longer trigger the dance.
- Diagnostic logging is now gated behind `"debug": true` in the config.

### Added

- Pickup detection via a Mixin on `ClientPacketListener.handleTakeItemEntity` (local player only, matched by entity id).
- `config/specialist-dance.json` — enabled/debug toggles, association timeouts and radius, and animation duration/size/position/cooldown.

### Fixed

- Drop association now reads the item stack on a later client tick, because the spawn packet arrives before the item data. Without this, drops were misidentified as stone, dirt and the like.

## Tracked ores

| Ore | Drop |
|---|---|
| Diamond Ore / Deepslate Diamond Ore | Diamond |
| Emerald Ore / Deepslate Emerald Ore | Emerald |
| Gold Ore / Deepslate Gold Ore | Raw Gold |
| Nether Gold Ore | Gold Nugget |
| Iron Ore / Deepslate Iron Ore | Raw Iron |
| Ancient Debris | Ancient Debris |

## Install

1. Install Fabric Loader for 1.21.11 and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).
2. Drop `specialist-dance-1.2.0.jar` into your `mods/` folder.

Client-side only — the server doesn't need it. Full config reference in the [README](https://github.com/Sebasjgg27/specialist-dance-mc#configuration).
